items.title: Digital Limits and OEI Operations
items.description: AW169 EP engine and transmission digital limitations, Safe OEI Flight, and the cockpit power-limit warning logic — including what's actually different from standard AW169.

items.title: TCAS II Procedures and Limits
items.description: How TCAS II actually works on the AW169 EP — TA/RA logic, resolution advisory maneuvers, the altitude inhibit table and every aural message.

items.title: HTAWS: Offshore and Onshore Modes
items.description: How the AW169 EP terrain awareness and warning system works, including the offshore-specific modes, SAR sensitivity mode and alerts not present on standard AW169.

items.title: Checkride: Operating Limits and Performance
items.description: A checkride-style run-through of AW169 EP operating limits and performance — weight, speed, and power figures a pilot needs cold for an oral exam.

items.title: ADELT: Activation Logic and Procedures
items.description: How the AW169 EP's Automatic Deployable ELT (Crash Position Indicator) works — automatic and manual activation logic, cockpit controls, and every limitation and procedure.

items.title: The AFCS Flight Control Stack
items.description: How the AW169 EP's Automatic Flight Control System is built up layer by layer, followed through a real departure and approach to show how the modes actually work together in flight.
